stories.title: First Minister rejects claim north Wales missing from Plaid’s new ‘Programme for Government’
stories.summary: Flintshire, Deeside and Wrexham are not mentioned anywhere in the Welsh Government’s new four-year programme, and the First Minister has rejected claims that north Wales has been overlooked. stories.title: Flintshire village clears final hurdle to adopt Welsh name Pentre Moch
stories.summary: Northop Hall has been granted permission to formally adopt its historic welsh name – Pentre Moch. Flintshire County Council has formally approved the official use of Pentre Moch – which translates as ‘Pig Holding’ or ‘Pig Village’ – as the primary Welsh name for the village.
